idiom_name: explicit parameters / constructor injection by argument
implementation_notes: Python's default answer is the language-neutral one: pass the object into the function or constructor that uses it. Because there is no compiler to catch a mis-forwarded value, keep the relay short, use keyword arguments for clarity, and let frameworks that build object graphs (web frameworks, dependency-injection libraries) supply the dependency at the boundary so intermediate functions do not have to. Type hints plus a type checker recover part of the safety that a static language gives the relay for free.
pitfalls: Without a type checker, a mis-forwarded parameter surfaces only at runtime; annotate intermediary functions so the chain is auditable.
Mutable default arguments used as relayed defaults are shared across calls - the classic Python trap when modelling missing context.

variants.name: ContextVar ambient per-context state (PEP 567)
variants.implementation_notes: The standard library's replacement for ambient per-request state is `contextvars`: a module-level `ContextVar` holds a value isolated per execution context (thread, asyncio task, or explicitly copied context), so a value set at the request boundary is readable by any awaiting coroutine without being threaded through every call. The documentation recommends Context Variables over `threading.local()` in concurrent code precisely to stop state bleeding between requests; use them for request-scoped infrastructure (request id, tenant, locale), not for ordinary dependencies, which stay explicit parameters.
variants.code_sketch:
from contextvars import ContextVar

current_tenant: ContextVar[Tenant] = ContextVar("current_tenant")

current_tenant.set(tenant)        # set once at the request boundary
tenant = current_tenant.get()     # read deep in the call chain
pitfalls: Context Variables must be created at module top level, never inside a closure: `Context` objects hold strong references, so per-call variables leak.
A default of `None` hides a missing boundary - raise or assert in the consumer instead of letting the default reach a leaf.
